tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.name: Implement Problem Library Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage problem data, including retrieval and search functionality.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Create and configure the database schema to store problem details, tags, and difficulty levels.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code for evaluation.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to compile, run, and evaluate user-submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user profiles, including solved problems and statistics.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data, including profile information and activity tracking.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard with user rankings.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and update user rankings based on problem-solving performance.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Explanations UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface to display hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Explanations Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected, including search and filtering.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the code submission and evaluation system works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles display correct data and statistics.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard displays accurate rankings and updates correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment, ensuring all features are functional.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems using wireframes and modern UI frameworks.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for compatibility across devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure API endpoints.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and future scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a clean and intuitive UI for users to write, test, and submit code using a code editor component like Monaco Editor.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a secure backend system to evaluate submitted code in isolated environments using Docker or a sandboxing tool.
T5.notes: Ensure proper handling of timeouts and malicious code.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page UI to display user details, achievements, and activity history using a modern frontend framework.
T6.notes: Incorporate customization options for user profiles.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, achievements, and activity logs using a secure authentication system.
T7.notes: Ensure data privacy and implement role-based access control.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users with sorting and filtering options using a dynamic table component.

T9.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings based on user performance metrics.
T9.notes: Optimize for frequent updates and large datasets.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a UI to display hints and explanations for problems with collapsible sections for better readability.
T10.notes: Ensure hints are accessible only after specific conditions are met.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and explanations, linking them to specific problems in the database.
T11.notes: Implement version control for content updates.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library functionality, including search, filter, and problem details.
T12.notes: Use automated testing tools like Selenium for efficiency.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy, security, and performance under various scenarios.
T13.notes: Simulate edge cases and high-concurrency situations.

T14.implementation_approach: Verify user profile features, including data accuracy, customization, and activity tracking.
T14.notes: Test with different user roles and permissions.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard for correct ranking calculations, sorting, and real-time updates.

T16.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud service like AWS or Azure, ensuring proper CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools are in place.
T16.notes: Conduct final security and performance checks before launch.
